title: This Fungus Turns Ants Into Zombies 🧟 #shorts

lines.say: A fungus can turn an ant into a zombie.

visual.prompt: extreme macro of a single carpenter ant on a green leaf in a dark rainforest, eerie pale fungal threads creeping from its joints

lines.say: And it does it without ever entering its brain.

visual.bgPrompt: glowing translucent ant head in x-ray style, dark background

lines.say: An infected carpenter ant stops walking with its colony.

visual.prompt: a long trail of carpenter ants on a forest floor at dusk, one ant breaking away from the line

lines.say: It wanders off alone, up a small plant.

visual.prompt: a lone ant climbing the thin stem of a tiny rainforest sapling, shallow depth of field

lines.say: Then, around solar noon, it bites down hard.

visual.prompt: midday sun beams piercing a dense rainforest canopy, view straight up from the forest floor

lines.say: On a leaf vein, about twenty five centimeters up.

visual.label: above the forest floor
visual.bgPrompt: underside of a large rainforest leaf with a prominent central vein, backlit

lines.say: Its jaw muscles waste away, locking it there.

visual.prompt: extreme macro of ant mandibles clamped onto a leaf vein, dramatic side light
holographic 3D scan of an ant body floating in a dark laboratory, wireframe and cross-sections

lines.say: The fungus had wrapped networks around its muscles.

visual.prompt: microscopic view of glowing fungal hyphae networks wrapped around striated insect muscle fibers

lines.say: But not a single fungal cell was inside the brain.
Then a stalk grows out of the ant's head,

visual.prompt: a thin fungal stalk growing out of the head of a dead ant clinging to a leaf, misty rainforest

lines.say: ready to release spores on new victims.

visual.prompt: cloud of glowing fungal spores drifting through dark rainforest air, backlit by a golden beam

lines.say: Nature wrote the zombie story first.

visual.text: Nature wrote the zombie story first

lines.say: Follow for one fact a day that changes how you see the world.
